content: The brainwashing Easter egg in Grand Theft Auto 6 is a long side mission in which you get the chance to investigate long-forgotten bunkers where a certain president spent some time (and listened to rumba) and where brainwashing experiments had taken place. Like the Vice City portal Easter egg, you'll need to go through a series of steps to finish this mission, but there's no other option if you want to learn the truth about what the government hid from you.
